name: cody
description: Cody turns your notes into reviewers, drawings, quizzes, flashcards and games.

scripts.build:mobile: node scripts/build-mobile.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run build:mobile && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../Cody.apk
